Simon Says Game

The classic Simon memory game — watch the color sequence, repeat it back, and see how long a chain you can remember.

–
Level
0
Best

Press Start to play.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start and watch the sequence play.
  2. Tap the colored pads in the same order.
  3. Survive — each round adds one step to the chain.
  4. Try to beat your saved high score.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do you play?

Watch the pads light up in order, then tap them in the exact same order. Each round adds one more step.

Is my high score saved?

Your best score is saved in this browser, so you can try to beat it next time.

Does it get faster?

The game speeds up slightly as the sequence grows, keeping it challenging.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — it is fully playable with mouse or touch.
